title: Infernux v0.4.8 · Native Neural Execution
summary: Infernux 0.4.8 brings model authoring, native execution, and checkpoint export into the engine. Projects can connect neural inputs and outputs to their own game systems through the same resource and lifecycle boundaries used by rendering and physics.

items.title: Execute synchronous and managed CPU neural operations through the same native range recipe, retaining storage and compiled code until actual completion. Batch ordinary tensor, parameter and optimizer-state transfers through the shared CPU/Vulkan IO boundary.
items.text: Execute synchronous and managed CPU neural operations through the same native range recipe, retaining storage and compiled code until actual completion. Batch ordinary tensor, parameter and optimizer-state transfers through the shared CPU/Vulkan IO boundary.

items.title: Reuse native GPU forward recipes for inference and tracked training activations. Preserve input snapshots, aliased views, random-state ownership and complete model-parameter publication while retiring completed queue receipts and unused launch bindings.
items.text: Reuse native GPU forward recipes for inference and tracked training activations. Preserve input snapshots, aliased views, random-state ownership and complete model-parameter publication while retiring completed queue receipts and unused launch bindings.

items.title: Expose the shared host-work budget through Engine.work_budget. Budget changes reselect unsubmitted compute and model transfers without replaying accepted work or losing cross-frame progress.
items.text: Expose the shared host-work budget through Engine.work_budget. Budget changes reselect unsubmitted compute and model transfers without replaying accepted work or losing cross-frame progress.

items.title: Share gradient-clipping preparation between ordinary calls and training programs. Preserve strict float32 signed-zero, infinity and NaN behavior in generated SPIR-V and Vulkan capability checks.
items.text: Share gradient-clipping preparation between ordinary calls and training programs. Preserve strict float32 signed-zero, infinity and NaN behavior in generated SPIR-V and Vulkan capability checks.

items.title: Reduce repeated rigidbody pose publication and joint-batch overhead, share the engine worker pool with Jolt, and enable supported Release link-time optimization for the Jolt library. Convex-collider queries and gizmos now use the final cooked hull.
items.text: Reduce repeated rigidbody pose publication and joint-batch overhead, share the engine worker pool with Jolt, and enable supported Release link-time optimization for the Jolt library. Convex-collider queries and gizmos now use the final cooked hull.

items.title: Pause a failed physical step before publishing its results and require Stop before restarting, preventing partial integration from being replayed. Sample project model architectures remain unchanged.
items.text: Pause a failed physical step before publishing its results and require Stop before restarting, preventing partial integration from being replayed. Sample project model architectures remain unchanged.

items.title: Engine upgrades and hotfixes now replace the project's old runtime and install the selected engine, instead of only changing the project version record. Runtime replacement runs in a background worker with progress reporting. A Reinstall Project Runtime action repairs projects whose version record was already changed by an earlier Hub.
items.text: Engine upgrades and hotfixes now replace the project's old runtime and install the selected engine, instead of only changing the project version record. Runtime replacement runs in a background worker with progress reporting. A Reinstall Project Runtime action repairs projects whose version record was already changed by an earlier Hub.

items.title: Ordinary launches preserve the existing runtime and locally modified engine code. Startup logs identify the engine actually loaded without rewriting the preferred version.
items.text: Ordinary launches preserve the existing runtime and locally modified engine code. Startup logs identify the engine actually loaded without rewriting the preferred version.

items.title: Remove exact project-version rejection from source Editor and headless entry points. A recorded project version is used to provision a missing runtime, not to override an existing one.
items.text: Remove exact project-version rejection from source Editor and headless entry points. A recorded project version is used to provision a missing runtime, not to override an existing one.

items.title: Remove inherited development-only native module and compiler paths when launching a project's installed runtime. Hub no longer uses an empty native-directory override that the installed engine can interpret as the project directory.
items.text: Remove inherited development-only native module and compiler paths when launching a project's installed runtime. Hub no longer uses an empty native-directory override that the installed engine can interpret as the project directory.

items.title: Verified the complete Hub-to-editor startup path with a project's private Python runtime. This is a Hub-only release; the published engine and plugin versions remain unchanged.
items.text: Verified the complete Hub-to-editor startup path with a project's private Python runtime. This is a Hub-only release; the published engine and plugin versions remain unchanged.

items.title: Define models with infernux.nn and run supported training and inference on native CPU or Vulkan. Managed requests keep their intermediate state across host frames and publish results at the consumer boundary.
items.text: Define models with infernux.nn and run supported training and inference on native CPU or Vulkan. Managed requests keep their intermediate state across host frames and publish results at the consumer boundary.

items.title: Use a shared host-frame budget for ready work, including headless execution. RenderGraph and NeuralGraph keep independent dependencies and share device submission and completion infrastructure.
items.text: Use a shared host-frame budget for ready work, including headless execution. RenderGraph and NeuralGraph keep independent dependencies and share device submission and completion infrastructure.

items.title: Save a published model in an .inm checkpoint with a readable structure header and binary weights. Projects can reload it for inference or continued training in the Editor or a matching packaged Player.
items.text: Save a published model in an .inm checkpoint with a readable structure header and binary weights. Projects can reload it for inference or continued training in the Editor or a matching packaged Player.

items.title: Capture camera views continuously or on request. Cameras can publish to a RenderTexture asset or to memory, and consumers can keep using the latest completed image.
items.text: Capture camera views continuously or on request. Cameras can publish to a RenderTexture asset or to memory, and consumers can keep using the latest completed image.

items.title: Expose editable skeleton hierarchies and Jolt joints and ragdolls. Model results can be applied at explicit physics and rendering boundaries.
items.text: Expose editable skeleton hierarchies and Jolt joints and ragdolls. Model results can be applied at explicit physics and rendering boundaries.

items.title: Improve asset preparation and preview publication with shared IO and transfer budgets. Native PNG and JPEG paths reserve their decoding workspace. Asset refresh, watching, and model Apply use the native sidecar parser and preserve the revision they consumed.
items.text: Improve asset preparation and preview publication with shared IO and transfer budgets. Native PNG and JPEG paths reserve their decoding workspace. Asset refresh, watching, and model Apply use the native sidecar parser and preserve the revision they consumed.

items.title: Prepare scene geometry on open using bounded Vulkan upload batches. Scene camera movement updates gizmo icons in the current frame and keeps their picking aligned.
items.text: Prepare scene geometry on open using bounded Vulkan upload batches. Scene camera movement updates gizmo icons in the current frame and keeps their picking aligned.

items.title: Bundle MCP 0.2.1 with restored checkpoint operations. The official catalog includes Tween 0.3.1 and Text Animator 0.1.4, which handles empty animation curves.
items.text: Bundle MCP 0.2.1 with restored checkpoint operations. The official catalog includes Tween 0.3.1 and Text Animator 0.1.4, which handles empty animation curves.

items.title: Update the Hub and platform packaging for engine 0.4.8. Install platform packages built for this exact engine release before exporting a Player.
